system.description:
Warriors Zone · cast at S-Rank · no type

+8 DR.

A creature crossing into your weapon's reach takes your [Weapon Damage] + 5d6, once per turn (you choose which creatures).

Chain 1: the first weapon attack each turn with this weapon can attack a second creature as part of the same action.

Bukijutsu you cast with this weapon gain a rank of Mastery to the attack.
